appearance.extreme: They're a different shape from one week to the next. Right now they're pale and thick-hided and shedding, and next week they won't be.
appearance.obvious: Their skin has visibly changed texture across the exposed parts, thickened where the weather has been at it.
appearance.subtle: Their skin looks slightly different from the last time you saw them.

description: Your body has started solving problems on its own. Whatever is trying to kill you today, you're a little more resistant to it by evening.
name: Adaptive Flesh
